name: Deadlock Sync
detail.live: Live memory reading is enabled. History recovery waits while you play.
detail.backfill: Recovering the current eligible Steam account first. Switching accounts updates priority; opening Deadlock gives live sync priority.
detail.paused: Automatic recovery is off. Sync starts again next time you open Deadlock or launch Deadlock Match Backfill.
detail.idle: Starts with Deadlock or when you launch Deadlock Match Backfill.
detail.caught_up: No recovery is due. We will check again after your next game session.
detail.waiting_for_account: Your current account’s available history has been processed. You can choose a waiting account in Steam whenever you want to recover its history. Recovery retries automatically when Deadlock is closed and any cooldown has ended.
detail.game: Live sync takes priority. History recovery resumes after Deadlock closes, once any cooldown ends.
detail.recovery.rate_limit: This Steam account is cooling down. Other eligible remembered accounts can continue; the current account gets priority when eligible. Steam did not provide a reset time.
detail.recovery.transient: A temporary error interrupted recovery. The next attempt is scheduled automatically.
detail.recovery.account_in_use: Steam reports this account is playing a game. Recovery will retry when the account is available.
detail.recovery.auth: Steam could not use this account’s saved sign-in. Open the account in Steam, complete any sign-in Steam asks for, then choose Try again.
detail.recovery.choose_account: Choose an account in Steam to resume recovery automatically when Deadlock is closed and any cooldown has ended.
detail.recovery.unavailable: Some history is unavailable. Automatic recovery has stopped for those matches.
detail.recovery.state_store: Recovery tracking could not be read or saved. Check local storage access, then choose Try again.
detail.recovery.settling: Waiting briefly after the game closes before checking history.
Automatic recovery is enabled. Live sync always takes priority when Deadlock is open.

recovery.skipped.one: %1 older match reached the recovery attempt limit.
recovery.skipped.other: %1 older matches reached the recovery attempt limit.

detail.recovery.corrupt: Saved recovery tracking needs repair before automatic retries can resume. Live syncing can still run.
detail.live_failed: Live syncing stopped unexpectedly. Choose Try again to restart it; your game keeps running.
account.phase.auth: check this account’s sign-in in Steam
account.phase.choose_account: choose this account in Steam to retry automatically
detail.recovery.upload_rate_limit: The upload service limited requests. Both live and historical uploads wait until its shared cooldown ends.
detail.recovery.legacy_cooldown: A cooldown from the previous version could not be tied safely to one account. Its original deadline is preserved.
detail.recovery.account_metadata: Waiting for readable Steam account information. Recovery resumes automatically when Steam has finished updating its account list.
